colorSystem.primaryColorRole: single terra-cotta accent (brand-500 #D97757) reserved for primary CTA, focal card, and italic display accents
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single-hue brand identity, no secondary accent
colorSystem.stateColors: success-500 only for status pulse; no warning/info tokens

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius scale (8/12/16px) — no large rounded shapes
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Newsreader (display) + Lora (reading) + Poppins (UI) + Geist Mono (markers) with editorial italic accent
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base rhythm; generous vertical breathing in dark mode
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: three surface elevations: sunken (bg-50) / floating (bg-200) / emphasis (text-800 inverted)
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: paper-thin shadows; emphasis uses brand halo instead of heavy shadow
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: no decorative imagery; rely on typography, surface, and the warm accent as the focal gesture
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: static cover plate — no interactive states in v1

pages.title: Plate I · Cover
pages.businessScenario: design system cover / plate of an editorial series
pages.visualNorthStar: a quiet, paper-lit dark room where a single terra-cotta accent carries the entire emotional sentence
pages.compositionPattern: Editorial plate: margin numerals + brand header + display slogan + token strip + 3-elevation cluster + components lab + type spec + footer
